summary.intent: Group related pending todos (#5, #8, #9) into a GSD phase for SDK folder-state consolidation and share metadata hardening, then plan and begin executing it autonomously while the user is AFK.
summary.outcome: Phase 48 was created with an enriched goal (PR #498 regression promoted to P0 REQ-1), fully researched and planned (6 plans across 3 waves), and Wave 1 execution was initiated. A critical regression in PR #498 was discovered and became the blocking prerequisite gating all other work.

repo: web-e2e only auto-triggers via ci-e2e.yml on push to main — not on PRs or feature branches. Pre-merge validation requires manual dispatch: `env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh workflow run web-e2e.yml --ref <branch>`.
web-e2e.yml already supports workflow_dispatch with `ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}`, so no CI changes are needed to run it against a feature branch.

PR #498 introduced a regression: loadFolder calls folderTree.set() unconditionally, clobbering fresher in-memory state with a stale IPNS snapshot. Two specs fail: bin-restore-after-reload.spec.ts (added by #498) and full-workflow.spec.ts 6.6.2.

Phase 47 (PR #494) covered owned-folder consolidation. Phase 48 is the shared-folder layer — sharedFolderTree must be a sibling keyed by shareId, not an extension of folderTree, due to SharedWriteContext distinction and potential ipnsName collisions.
The API server is zero-knowledge, so it cannot re-encrypt existing plaintext itemName values — legacy rows require lazy client-side backfill, not a server-side data migration UPDATE.
GSD branching_strategy 'phase' creates a new branch off HEAD rather than reusing the branch already established for the phase, producing a confusingly named second branch.
TypeORM migration command for this repo: `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run`; `pnpm api:generate` is required after any API schema changes.

code.finding: loadFolder calls folderTree.set() unconditionally here — fix is a sequenceNumber guard (if existing.sequenceNumber >= resolved, keep existing) before this line.
ensureFolderLoaded short-circuit — must remain intact to avoid re-regressing #498.
DFS child-check — must remain intact to avoid re-regressing #498.
folder:updated event pattern — new sharedFolder:updated event for REQ-3 should mirror this shape.
Write-back currently done inline here — REQ-3 converts this to an event-fed projection from the SDK; withConflictRetry is dropped (CAS moves into the client).
Clone this migration for the REQ-4 itemName encryption column — additive nullable bytea column, no data UPDATE (zero-knowledge constraint).
encryptedIpnsKey field is the analog pattern for the new item_name_encrypted bytea column in REQ-4.
ECIES wrap for itemName should be added here, mirroring the existing encryptedKey flow.

workflow: When grouping todos, distinguish 'do together' (same branch, sequential dependency) from 'supersedes' (one makes the other obsolete) — they require different handling: co-execution vs. cross-linking with independent disposition.
A security finding should not be held open waiting for a long-horizon research idea that would subsume it — cross-link and close on its own merits.

GSD pattern mapper produces analog-based line-number references that the planner uses directly; running it as a separate pre-planning step prevents the planner from needing to re-derive file locations.

For unattended AFK execution: prefer sequential plan execution on the established branch over parallel worktrees to reduce failure modes; keep signing on but have a fallback plan for 1Password hanging.

friction: API stream idle timeout killed the initial fan-out research agent mid-response, requiring the user to restart the flow via a different GSD command.

GSD branching_strategy 'phase' created a second branch (feat/sdk-self-bootstrap-regression-fix-and-shared-folder-metadata) instead of staying on the already-established feat/phase-48-... branch, requiring manual history verification before proceeding.
1Password SSH signing requires interactive keychain access, which is a latent risk for unattended AFK commit runs.
web-e2e running only on main push meant PR #498's regression couldn't be caught pre-merge — the gap that motivates the new dispatch gate procedure.
